SY216
Aging in Social Context
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
takes a sociological approach to explore what happens to individuals, families, institutions, and nations as aging occurs. The impact of factors such as gender, class, race, ethnicity, sexuality, and religion on the experiences of older adults will also be explored.

Prerequisites
Registration Status: Senior Student

,
